conviction_note: No filing or news dated 10-08 or 10-09 explains today's -12.6% gap. What I found is a standing supply overhang: a $25m ATM that is effective and has room, authorized share capital raised to 50bn shares from the 10-07 open, and US$1.5m of cash against about US$13.7m of short-term borrowings at 30 June. That supports a small negative lean (p_up 45). Against it: volume is only 2.05x, the stock recovered +5.1% intraday, and its own falls have split 50/50; abs_move 8 reflects a 20.5% ATR. The findings sum and the scaled number are close (-1.0 vs -0.8) but were sized independently.
bar: Sized against this name's own comparable falls (n=132, median next close +0.1%, up-rate 50%, median abs 4.6%) and its 14-day ATR of 20.5%, both from the sealed baseline. findings.finding: An effective $25m at-the-market program (Pacific Century Securities, agreement dated 2026-08-07, 424B5 filed 2026-08-10 under F-3 333-286651) can sell Class A shares into any bounce on 2026-10-12. Authorized capital became 50bn shares from the 2026-10-07 open, and at 30 June the company held US$1.5m of cash against RMB97.9m (about US$13.7m) of short-term borrowings.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The ATM is effective now and sells through Nasdaq at the company's instruction, so it can draw during the 10-12 session itself without a further filing. The 50bn-share authorization removed any share-count ceiling as of 10-07, two sessions before the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the ATM opened in August the stock has fallen about 98% over 60 sessions, with repeated consecutive falls (08-21 -31%, then -17.5% next; 08-27 -7%, then -26.4% next; 10-08 -12.8%, then today's -8.1%). There were also sharp up-days (08-25 +29.6%, 10-06 +24.8%), so the supply has not prevented bounces.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has absorbed the overhang as a level, but an ATM's cost is a cap on any rebound in the next session: sales arrive as offers into strength. If the price held it, the intraday recovery would already have stalled on supply; instead it ran +5.1% off the gap, which is the kind of bounce an active ATM sells into. Whether the company is drawing right now is not observable, because the issuer reports ATM sales only periodically.
findings.independence: The company's own 1H26 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1954694/000149315226046090/ex99-1.htm) shows cash of US$1.5m, down from RMB30.3m at year-end, after deploying placement proceeds into partnership deposits. That is a separate document pointing to a funding need.

outside_window.finding: Conditional further share consolidation (10:1 to 80:1) approved at the 10-02 EGM. It triggers only after 5 to 20 consecutive closes below US$1.00, and spot is US$2.26.

Solvency and liquidity: US$1.5m of cash vs about US$13.7m of short-term borrowings at 30 June, with RMB279.4m in partnership deposits whose recoverability is undisclosed. This is a multi-week overhang, not a dated event.
